name: Shiina Mizuki
source:
The calm and serious homeroom teacher of the protagonist's class. She teaches geography and history. She is strict in class, which is why some students avoid her, thinking that she is pretty, but a little scary.

She is kind at heart, and shows concern about the protagonist's situation and him living alone. She doesn't realize that the protagonist is her childhood friend, but she is worried about him and can't ignore his situation.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc086/index.html#character]Official Site[/url]]
